introduction.text: The Criptoportico Neroniano is a Roman cryptoportico, a semi‑subterranean gallery that supported structures aboveground and provided cool storage. It exemplifies Roman engineering and the use of underground spaces for practical and architectural purposes.

history.description: Cryptoporticus were used as foundations for forums and villas, providing a cool, level podium for superstructures.

design.description: A cryptoportico is a covered corridor whose vaulting supports a portico aboveground and is lit by openings at the tops of its arches.
